together.title: Telnet is open
together.fix: Telnet sends everything, including passwords, in plain text. Turn Telnet off and use SSH instead.

together.title: Redis is open
together.fix: Redis has no login by default. Bind it to localhost only, or set a strong password.

together.title: Docker API is open without a login
together.fix: Anyone who can reach this port controls the whole machine. Turn off the plain TCP Docker API, or protect it with TLS.

together.title: FTP is open
together.fix: FTP sends passwords in plain text. Turn FTP off, or switch to SFTP.

together.title: Windows file sharing (SMB) is open
together.fix: Fine inside your home if you use file sharing. Never expose it to the internet, and turn off SMBv1.

together.title: SQL Server is open
together.fix: Database ports should only be reachable by the apps that need them, never by the whole network.

together.title: MySQL is open
together.fix: Database ports should only be reachable by the apps that need them, never by the whole network.

together.title: Remote Desktop is open
together.fix: RDP is a common break-in target. Turn it off when not in use, or reach it only over a VPN like Tailscale.

together.title: PostgreSQL is open
together.fix: Database ports should only be reachable by the apps that need them, never by the whole network.

together.title: VNC remote screen is open
together.fix: VNC is often weakly protected. Turn it off, or use it only over a VPN.

together.title: Elasticsearch is open
together.fix: Elasticsearch has no login by default and exposes its data. Bind it to localhost, or turn on security.

together.title: Memcached is open
together.fix: Memcached has no login and can leak its data. Bind it to localhost only.

together.title: MongoDB is open
together.fix: Database ports should only be reachable by the apps that need them, never by the whole network.

together.title: NFS file sharing is open
together.fix: NFS trusts the network by default. Limit exports to named machines, and keep it off the internet.

together.title: CouchDB is open
together.fix: Database ports should only be reachable by the apps that need them, never by the whole network.

together.title: Windows remote management (WinRM) is open
together.fix: WinRM gives remote command access. Turn it off when not in use, or reach it only over a VPN.

together.title: Kubernetes kubelet is open
together.fix: An open kubelet can run commands in containers. Turn off anonymous access and limit who can reach it.

together.title: Mail service is open
together.fix: Only expected on a mail server. Otherwise turn it off.

together.title: POP3 mail is open
together.fix: Old mail protocol. Turn it off unless you know you need it.

together.title: Windows RPC is open
together.fix: Normal on Windows, but it should never be reachable from the internet.

together.title: NetBIOS is open
together.fix: Old Windows sharing. Turn it off if you do not use old file sharing.

together.title: IMAP mail is open
together.fix: Only expected on a mail server. Otherwise turn it off.

together.title: Camera video stream (RTSP) is open
together.fix: Many cameras stream with no login here. Set a camera password and keep it off the internet.

together.title: MQTT is open
together.fix: MQTT brokers often allow anyone to read and send messages. Turn on a login, or bind it to the devices that need it.

together.title: rpcbind (portmapper) is open
together.fix: It lists the network services on this machine. Turn it off unless you use NFS.

together.title: LDAP directory is open
together.fix: Plain LDAP sends logins unencrypted. Use LDAPS, and limit who can reach it.

together.title: rsync is open
together.fix: rsync shares often need no login. Require a password, or limit it to the machines that sync.

together.title: Windows remote management over TLS is open
together.fix: WinRM gives remote command access. Turn it off when not in use, or reach it only over a VPN.

together.title: Kubernetes API is open
together.fix: Make sure anonymous access is off and only admins can reach it.

together.title: SSH is open
together.fix: OK if you use it. Use key login, turn off password login, and keep it off the internet.

together.title: DNS is open

together.title: Web service is open
